title: App shell: screen registry, fixed navigation tabs, project tab bar with agent tabs and "+", liquid-glass components from the tokens
summary: The renderer now opens in the liquid-glass frame from the prototype: screens self-register, fixed tabs Setup, Project, Map, Tickets and PRD, one tab per running agent with its waiting dot, a "+" tab, glass DOM components and a lint test that refuses any colour or spacing value outside the token file.

deferred.what: The per-agent-tab header slot is reachable only through the ShellContext passed to a screen mount, and the shell raises nothing when an agent tab is created, so the Open channel switch cannot appear on a new agent tab while another screen (Map) is open
deferred.why: Needs a small shell API decision (a hook on agent tab creation); the agent tab story (issue #78) would otherwise have to work outside its seam

deferred.what: setAgents re-appends every agent tab on each agents:list-changed, so a keyboard user focused on an agent tab or a control in its header slot loses focus whenever any agent waiting dot or title changes
deferred.why: Raised by the confirming review after the first approval, so recorded instead of another round
